verdict.rationale: The axis applies because GPUs ship developer SDKs. The RTX 5070 family page says it offers curated, GPU-optimized SDKs and models across Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch and other backends. The CUDA Toolkit documents GPU-accelerated libraries, a C/C++ compiler, a runtime, CUDA Tile C++ and cuTile Python for writing kernels, and the Nsight profiling tools, and NVIDIA's developer portal publishes an llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs on the 5070 Ti, explicit CUDA Toolkit documentation of Blackwell/5070 Ti support, and machine-readable docs beyond llms.txt (no .md docs pages).
